Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL PRODUCTION VFX ANIMATION SOURCE, NOT A CONCEPT SHEET. Create a transparent PNG sprite sheet for a premium 2D top-down / elevated three-quarter wuxia pixel-art RPG. NO characters, hands, weapons, ground, scenery, text, labels, frames, grid lines, borders, checkerboard or shadows. Real alpha transparency everywhere outside effects. Use the supplied approved concept ONLY as visual style/design reference, DO NOT copy/crop its pixels. Draw new VFX frames.
LAYOUT: exactly FOUR evenly spaced COLUMNS and THREE evenly spaced ROWS; 12 separate frames total; landscape canvas 1536x1024. Cell centers at x=192,576,960,1344 and y=171,512,853. Keep each effect wholly inside its cell with at least 60px clear margin all around, never crossing cells. Each row is a coherent four-frame sequence left to right. Anchor remains at cell center throughout sequence; do NOT auto-center the visible bounding box or change scale per frame. Every frame is meaningfully DIFFERENT, evolving shape and flame motion, not identical recolored copies.
STYLE: deliberate crisp PIXEL ART in large 4x4 pixel clusters intended for nearest-neighbor reduction, stepped contours, limited saturated fire palette: deep red edge, orange middle, gold-yellow core, tiny ivory highlights. No smoky gray, pale halos, bloom or translucent soft blur. Strong dragon identity in horns, whiskers and flame contours, but small readable effects for a 44 logical-pixel hero. Dark red outlines sparse, no black rectangular background. Edge pixels crisp, not blurred.
ROW1: four small OPEN-PALM RELEASE FLARES, a fire bud opens into a short fan then splits into a few tongues and dissipates; forward screen-right only, anchored center. Designed to sit just ahead of the character hand, NOT a giant circle or magical sigil.
ROW2: four SMALL DIRECTIONAL HIT IMPACT frames: compact contact spark -> sharp fan of gold-orange flame shards screen-right -> widening sparse red tongues -> a few tiny dying ember flecks. This must remain much smaller than a character at runtime. Anchor contact point at cell center, no fragments of enemy/character.
ROW3: four SHARED LINGERING FLAME FLICKER LOOP frames: 3-4 low separated little fire tongues/embers, changing silhouette each frame, empty gaps between them, not a circular floor or pool. These are reusable burn flecks, no ground decal.
Maintain same pixel density across all 12, even fixed spacing, transparent. This is new animation source for Hỏa Vân Chưởng / Cuồng Long Loạn Vũ.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW PRODUCTION ANIMATION PIXELS for Cái Bang fire-school skill VFX. TRANSPARENT PNG, real alpha. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight separate equal-cell frames on a landscape 1536x1024 canvas. Each cell 384x512; centers x=192,576,960,1344; y=256 and768. Invisible grid; NO letters, labels, numbers, border, background, checkerboard, scenery, character, body parts, weapons or floor. Effects confined to own cells with 70px minimum empty padding. Draw new original frames, never crop concept art. Each row is coherent four sequential distinct frames left-to-right, stable anchor at center and consistent pixel scale/size. CRISP PIXEL ART using 4x4 pixel clusters, not high resolution smooth illustration. Red edge / orange core / gold highlights / tiny ivory hot spots. Transparent gaps between flame tongues, no blurred bloom or smoke. The approved concept sheet is visual motif guidance only. Top-down/elevated orthographic 2D combat effects, readable alongside a small 44px hero.
HỎA VÂN CHƯỞNG. ROW 1: FOUR FRAME LOOP of ONE SINGLE small narrow flaming palm/dragon-snouted bolt facing RIGHT. Every frame exactly ONE bolt with one little dragon snout at front, flame taper tail behind to left, same nose position and same overall length, flowing tongues change silhouette between frames. No spawning multiple projectiles inside a frame; three shots will be three separate instances in game. Compact pointed gold palm-energy leading edge, small horn/whisker flame accents. Keep silhouette about 220px wide and100px tall on source, NOT larger.
ROW2: FOUR FRAME small palm impact animation: small sharp contact flare at center -> flame-palm fan to right -> sparse tongues retracting -> few separated embers. Growing then fading, same contact origin. No dragon explosion or floor circle. Intended native projectile ~42x20px and impact ~40x32px. KEEP HARD EDGES AND NO SOFT GLOW; true transparent background.

Facing right, tiny tapered tail left. Frame differences are swirling flame tongue motion around one orb, NOT progressively changing into multiple projectiles. Gold snout and horns readable, red negative-space hollow behind face. This ONE projectile explodes at collision; no homing, no physical animal.
ROW2: four-stage area EXPLOSION, all centered identically: compact ignition spark -> broad low outward red-gold dragon curls with an OPEN TRANSPARENT CENTER and many ground-visible gaps -> separated peripheral flame tongues -> sparse dying embers. No filled fire disk, no circle outline, no rune, no opaque smoke. Max source width280px, height200px. Explosion is seen elevated 3/4 with shallow ground footprint; no floor texture. Native target projectile40px diameter; impact100px across with sparse flames. Separate small shared burning flickers will be reused from another asset, so no extra row needed. Keep HARD PIXEL CLUSTERS and no luminous haze.

The wave is wide across travel direction, about220px source width and200px source height, low flame silhouette, ground-visible openings. No entire opaque animal, no magic circle, no floor texture.

ROW1: four-stage BUFF ACTIVATION. Small wrist-sized gold spark -> one small dragon-shaped flame ribbon rises from lower-left toward upper-right -> ribbon curls BACK INWARD toward center, gathering rather than attacking -> two small separated wrist flame tufts with tiny dragon eyebrow accent above. Keep cell CENTER area EMPTY, an invisible character's body would occupy center; no opaque fire crossing face or chest. Effect width about180sourcepx, native50px. All art is around PERIPHERY of empty central space, not a circle outline or magic rune. No character or wrist drawn.
ROW2: four-frame subdued BUFF LOOP: two separated warm golden-red wrist flame tufts at lower left and lower right, and one tiny dragon-whisker curl high to one side. Flickering flame tongues move every frame but keep wrist anchor locations and modest size consistent. At least60% of bounding region remains transparent. No full body aura, no full dragon, no floor sigil. This layer must sit around approved 44px body without obscuring it. True transparency and hard pixel edges.

ROW1: four-stage advancing BROAD shallow fire-front, all pointing RIGHT: two small braided flame heads gathering -> THREE recognizable small Chinese dragon heads nested within ONE unified advancing flame crest -> wide full crest with open transparent gaps between red-gold flame ribbons -> breaking low forward tongues. The three heads belong to ONE wave, never separate missiles. Maintain source dimensions within300px wide by260px tall, frontal crest taller across lane than small Hỏa Vân bolt. Strong angular fire ribbons, open gaps, no opaque fire carpet or full-bodied dragons. Native wave target about130x100px.
ROW2: four frames of terminal forward eruption: compact leading contact -> gold jagged burst along RIGHTWARD front -> several separated fading red-orange dragon whisker curls -> few tiny ember shards. Contact points and shape centers aligned across cells. Grandest PALM skill via intricate flame silhouette, NOT a screen-filling yellow disk. Ensure visible ground/targets through at least half the wave bounding box. No camera shake, debris terrain, stun icons or lingering burn floor implied.
